spans.s: नपुंस् m. Not a man, a eunuch.
नपुंस् m. Not a man, a eunuch.
नपुंसक (I) m.n. 1. A hermaphrodite; 2. an impotent man, a eunuch; 3. a coward.
नपुंसक (II) n. 1. A word in the neuter gender; 2. the neuter gender.
नप्तृ m. A grandson (a son’s son or a daughter’s son).
नप्त्री f. A grand-daughter (a son’s daughter or a daughter’s daughter).
नापित m. A barber, a shaver, M.iv.253.
नापित-शाला f. a shaving house, a hair-cutting saloon.
नापित्य n. The trade of a barber.
